title: vanta ui
brief: VantaUI is a UI library built from real products — production-grade site templates, app templates, components, blocks and Figma files for Next.js, React and LLM-assisted builds, from @vanta_ui. It doubles as a reference for how world-class products handle UI patterns, copywriting and user flows.
details: VantaUI is a UI library built from real products — production-grade site templates, app templates, components, blocks, and Figma files, pitched as a shortcut past the blank canvas for Next.js, React, and LLM-assisted builds. Its angle is "more than inspiration": instead of generic kit components it documents how actual world-class products handle UI patterns, copywriting, and user flows, so it doubles as a design reference. The homepage leads with latest additions and reviews from developers and studios using it as their go-to UI reference. From @vanta_ui.
